name: KXHIGH late-afternoon favourite carry
description: Taker buy of the KXHIGH bracket priced 85-97c, 6-10 h before the local-midnight close (first taker-buy print proves the ask), one entry per bracket, held to settlement.
hypothesis: Late-afternoon favourites in temperature ladders win more often than priced (development trade screen +1..+3c net at 6-10 h; 4-6 h bucket negative because informed takers are on the other side by then). Counterparty: retail bracket-spreaders pricing off the NWS point forecast. Wrong if the walk-forward pooled CI <= 0, <60% months positive, or the lockbox loses. Risk: screen used trade prices, not asks.
